'''February 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Junior's Comics, Austin, TX on 10 February 2001. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1724">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-austin-tx-2-10-01d1724/ austin-tx-2-10-01], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-austin-tx-2-10-01d1724/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's Comics, Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
